purpose: Requirements for automatic selection between document search backends (doc-link, doc-db) in the query-db and update-db wrappers, including availability, freshness, unprepared index handling and failure rules.
summary: Overview and scope of the four query-db-*/update-db-* wrappers and backend selection
Preconditions defining usable doc-link and the doc-db status identifier requirement
Usage flow with an ordered backend list and per-backend availability judgment
Functional requirements FNC-001 to FNC-004: selection, query, update, route notification
BL-001 selection order, default order and invalid configuration error
BL-002 index freshness: backend-owned checks and session-change confirmation
BL-004 unprepared index versus failure, user approval, zero-document handling
BL-005 to BL-007: series scoping, explicit backend designation, index population ownership
Non-functional requirements: observability, backward compatibility, responsiveness, availability, information protection
Error case table mapping conditions to behaviors
tasks: Designing or changing backend selection logic of query-db and update-db wrappers
Reviewing backend fallback and failure handling behavior
Writing tests for wrapper error cases and notifications
Changing the default backend order or preferred backend setting
title: REQ-014 doc-db バックエンド選択 要件定義書
